svg.title: Topographic contours around Southwell, Nottinghamshire
svg.desc: A subtle vector background derived from public elevation data covering countryside approximately ten kilometres around Southwell.
svg.metadata: Centre: Southwell, Nottinghamshire (approximately 53.078 N, 0.955 W). Extent: 53.16 N to 52.99 N; 1.10 W to 0.79 W. Elevation source: Terrain Tiles, Registry of Open Data on AWS; Terrarium format, zoom 12. Generated at 5 metre contour intervals. No embedded raster imagery.
